description: Data model diagram, wide 16:9. Left two thirds: a large light sky-blue rounded box titled 'Session' with subtitle 'one conversation, session.id'. Inside it, near the top, three white rounded boxes in a row: 'Trace: turn 1', 'Trace: turn 2', 'Trace: turn 3'. Below 'Trace: turn 3', inside the session box, three white boxes stacked vertically, joined to 'Trace: turn 3' by a thin tree line: 'Agent: invoke_agent', 'Generation: chat, model and tokens', 'Tool: execute_tool'. Right column, three boxes stacked top to bottom, each with exactly one connection. Top right: a green box 'Score' with subtitle 'name, value, comment'; one straight horizontal arrow from Score pointing left to 'Trace: turn 3', labelled 'attached to'. Middle right, at the same height as the Generation box: a white box 'Prompt' with subtitle 'versions and labels'; one straight horizontal arrow from Prompt pointing left to the 'Generation: chat, model and tokens' box, labelled 'version used'. Bottom right: a white box 'Dataset' containing two small grey boxes 'Item' and 'Item'; one arrow from Dataset pointing left to a white box 'Experiment run' placed below the session box; one dashed arrow from Experiment run up to 'Trace: turn 1' labelled 'one trace per item'. No other lines. labels as plain text, no brackets, no quotation marks around labels. Wide 16:9 landscape composition.
